newsitem.title: UK: British Borneo upgrades hopes for Morpeth.
newsitem.headline: British Borneo upgrades hopes for Morpeth.

text.p: British Borneo Petroleum Syndicate Plc (BBPS) said on Thursday that it had upgraded calculations of the oil and gas reserves in, and anticipated production rates from, its wholly-controlled Morpeth field in the Gulf of Mexico.

The firm said that as a result of interpretation of well test data, consultants Miller & Lents now estimated the field would contain proven and probable reserves of 66 mmtsb oil and 67 bcf gas (total 77 mmboe), "representing an increase of some 50 percent over the previous estimate".

"Feasibility design work continues on the basis of this new information and a formal decision on field development will be taken in the next few weeks," BBPS added, saying it anticipated development costs in the range of $210 million. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
